Bitcoin Spot ETFs Saw Total Net Outflows of $283 Million Yesterday, Marking Three Consecutive Days of Net Outflows On September 10 (ET), Bitcoin spot ETFs recorded total net outflows of $283 million, marking three consecutive days of net outflows. Ethereum spot ETFs saw total net outflows of $29.76 million, while BlackRock’s ETHB led inflows with $13.95 million. — link

Onchain RWA Perpetual Trading Volume Surpasses $120 Billion, Up Approximately 120x From October 2025 Castle Labs reported that onchain RWA perpetual trading volume rose from less than $1 billion in October 2025 to more than $120 billion in August 2026, representing approximately 120x growth in under a year. RWA perpetuals accounted for about 20% of total onchain perpetual trading volume at one point in July, and around 12%–13% in most months. Monthly volume has remained above $100 billion since June. Current open interest in RWA perpetuals stands at approximately $4.9 billion, with TradeXYZ and Variational accounting for nearly 90%. — link

Binance’s Bitcoin Reserves Hit a Two-Year High at 693k BTC, Accounting for 30% of Major Exchange Reserves According to Darkfost, Binance’s BTC reserves have risen to more than 693k BTC, accounting for around 30% of the total BTC reserves held by major exchanges. The reserves have increased by 77k BTC since late April. The increase may be related to investors moving BTC to exchanges to sell after the rallies in May and recently. It may also have been influenced by the SAFU fund’s plan to invest $1 billion to acquire around 15k BTC, as well as some investors transferring BTC to exchanges for asset security following the ColdCard incident. The sharp rise in reserves could create potential selling pressure on the market. — link

India Launches Tokenized Bond Pilot for $620B Corporate Debt Market India’s securities regulator SEBI and the Reserve Bank of India have launched the Demat 2.0 pilot to test tokenized corporate bonds on distributed ledger technology. The pilot uses the RBI’s wholesale digital rupee for atomic settlement, allowing securities and payments to settle simultaneously on-chain. REC, L&T and IIFL have issued a combined ₹10.25 billion ($116 million) in bonds under the program, which forms part of India’s broader push to modernize its roughly $620 billion corporate debt market. — link
